note: Community 3D models embedded from Sketchfab on a species page. Embedding is not downloading: the model stays on Sketchfab's servers and their viewer draws it in an iframe, so this file records only what the page needs to credit the author - and scripts/check-embeds.mjs refuses any entry whose licence is outside the project's allow-list (CC0 / CC BY). Same rule as data/model-attribution.json, applied to models this project does not host.
